column1: # mapping_set_description: Manually curated alignment of the Mellea LinkML schema (linkml/src/mellea/schema/mellea.yaml) to the FINOS Common Domain Model (CDM) event-position module (cdm_event_position.yaml). The two schemas have essentially no domain overlap (AI runtime/code architecture vs financial position aggregation), so all mappings here are structural/aggregation analogues at low confidence. Provided for completeness rather than substantive equivalence.

column8: Both are top-level aggregation containers (code snapshot vs portfolio of positions). Structural analogue only.
RepositoryCatalog is a state-full snapshot of analysed elements at a point in time; PortfolioState is a state-full snapshot of positions at a point in time.
PythonPackage is the atomic packaging unit grouped by RepositoryCatalog; Position is the atomic unit grouped by Portfolio. Aggregation-shape analogy only.
Both are abstract base classes used to derive concrete domain elements in their respective schemas.
Both gather multiple identifiers issued by different systems for the same entity (model vs position).
Both serve as named, identifiable record types in their schemas; semantics are otherwise unrelated.
